disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部渠道适配器与配置解析逻辑：各渠道令牌只用于向用户配置的官方通知服务发送消息，未发现把令牌发往其他地址的代码路径；敏感字段有统一脱敏登记，日志只回显末 4 位。
checked_items.en: All channel adapters and configuration parsing logic were checked: each channel token is only used to send messages to the user-configured official notification service, no code path sending tokens to other addresses was found; sensitive fields are uniformly masked in logs, only the last 4 characters are echoed.

checked_items.zh: 检查了凭证存取面：管理台 token 只以 SHA-256 哈希落盘、明文仅首启打印一次；state 文件以 0600 权限原子写入并带跨进程写锁；未发现读取系统级密钥文件（如 ~/.ssh、.aws 等）的代码。
checked_items.en: Checked credential access surfaces: admin console tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes, plaintext is printed only once on first startup; state file is atomically written with 0600 permissions and cross-process write lock; no code reading system-level key files (e.g., ~/.ssh, .aws, etc.) was found.

checked_items.zh: 未检出凭据枚举或批量搜集行为，也未检出钱包/助记词等金融资产读取面。
checked_items.en: No credential enumeration or batch collection behavior detected, nor any financial asset reading surfaces such as wallets/mnemonics.

evidence.zh: 凭证只流向各渠道官方 API 或用户配置的 webhook（src/adapters/*、src/inbound/* 内端点均为官方域名），未发现读取系统密钥文件后再外发的组合路径；凭证落盘文件 0600 且管理台仅回环监听。
evidence.en: Credentials flow only to each channel's official API or user-configured webhook (endpoints in src/adapters/*, src/inbound/* are all official domains); no combined path of reading system key files followed by outbound exfiltration was found; credential files on disk are 0600 and admin console only listens on loopback.

checked_items.zh: 审查了全部注册工具的描述文本：notify、notify_test、ask_user 三个工具的说明均为正常功能描述，无系统指令、无凭据诱导、无安装/改配置诱导措辞，且均带每分钟限流。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all registered tool descriptions: descriptions of the three tools notify, notify_test, and ask_user are normal functional descriptions, no system instructions, no credential elicitation, no installation/configuration manipulation wording, and each carries per-minute rate limiting.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描了 agent 指令文件（AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、.claude、.cursor 等）与文档、README、配置注释：未发现任何指令面文件，也未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、隐藏 HTML 注释等注入文本。
checked_items.en: Full-tree scan of agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, .claude, .cursor, etc.), documentation, README, and configuration comments: no instruction surface file was found, nor any injection text such as instruction overrides, system message masquerading, hidden HTML comments.

checked_items.zh: 未检出提示词注入措辞，工具 schema 参数无诱导填写凭据字段。
checked_items.en: No prompt injection wording detected, tool schema parameters contain no fields inducing credential entry.

evidence.zh: 三个工具的描述原样进入模型请求面，逐条语义审查未见注入措辞；源码中未使用系统提示片段注入面（src/tool-register.mjs、src/questions/router.mjs）。
evidence.en: The descriptions of the three tools enter the model request surface as-is, semantic review line by line found no injection wording; source code does not use system prompt fragment injection surfaces (src/tool-register.mjs, src/questions/router.mjs).

evidence.zh: 工具描述无诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；notify 工具带每分钟调用限流，可抑制提示注入驱动的刷渠道行为（src/tool-register.mjs）。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions contain no wording inducing plugin installation, configuration modification, or permission escalation; the notify tool carries per-minute call rate limiting, which can suppress prompt-injection-driven channel flooding (src/tool-register.mjs).

checked_items.zh: 扫描了危险执行面：生产代码中无 eval、new Function、动态解码执行等模式；唯一的子进程调用是桌面通知（src/adapters/desktop.mjs）与扫码登录 CLI（scripts/channel-login.mjs），均以参数数组直传、不经 shell 拼接，且带转义、长度钳制与超时，属声明能力范围内的正常使用。
checked_items.en: Scanned dangerous execution surfaces: production code contains no eval, new Function, dynamic decoding execution, etc.; the only subprocess calls are desktop notifications (src/adapters/desktop.mjs) and QR code login CLI (scripts/channel-login.mjs), both invoked with argument array directly, no shell concatenation, and with escaping, length clamping, and timeout—normal usage within declared capability scope.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子：package.json 无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 脚本（静态扫描命中的两处 install 字段是元数据对象键，不是 npm 生命周期钩子）。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks: package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare scripts (the two install fields statically hit are metadata object keys, not npm lifecycle hooks).

checked_items.zh: 检查了树内执行载体：仅有 .github/workflows/ci.yml，内容为跑测试与校验零依赖，无外联、无下载执行；无 .husky、lefthook、devcontainer、Makefile、.gitmodules。
checked_items.en: Checked in-tree execution carriers: only .github/workflows/ci.yml exists, content is running tests and verifying zero dependencies, no outbound connections, no download-and-execute; no .husky, lefthook, devcontainer, Makefile, .gitmodules.

checked_items.zh: 未检出混淆代码（无超长行、高熵块、动态解码组合）。
checked_items.en: No obfuscated code detected (no excessively long lines, high-entropy blocks, dynamic decode combinations).

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一条插件行插入（空 channels 配置），无 !!js 标量，不存在配置即执行面。
evidence.en: The patch configuration cordis.patch.yml contains only one plugin line insertion (empty channels configuration), no !!js scalar, no configuration-as-execution surface.

evidence.zh: 全树未引用 cordis_define / cordis_run 等动态包执行工具，无 self-modification 面。
evidence.en: Full tree does not reference cordis_define / cordis_run or other dynamic package execution tools, no self-modification surface.

evidence.zh: 无安装钩子；依赖均为 registry 包版本引用（非 git 分支浮动引用）；CI 工作流仅运行测试（.github/workflows/ci.yml）。
evidence.en: No install hooks; dependencies are all registry package version references (not git branch floating refs); CI workflow only runs tests (.github/workflows/ci.yml).

evidence.zh: manifest 未声明 dsh.client（无浏览器 bundle 自动加载面），不适用。
evidence.en: Manifest does not declare dsh.client (no browser bundle auto-load surface), not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络端点：均为各通知渠道官方 API（Telegram、钉钉、飞书、QQ、WxPusher、pushplus、Server酱、Bark、企业微信、ntfy、Gotify 等）或用户配置的 webhook 地址，未发现裸 IP、个人域名、paste/gist 等带外通道。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network endpoints: all are official APIs of each notification channel (Telegram, DingDing, Feishu, QQ, WxPusher, pushplus, Server酱, Bark, WeCom, ntfy, Gotify, etc.) or user-configured webhook addresses, no raw IPs, personal domains, paste/gist-style out-of-band channels found.

checked_items.zh: 未检出编码外发链（无 base64/压缩变换后发送敏感数据的组合），未检出端点劫持（无把环境变量或端点指向非官方地址的代码）。
checked_items.en: No encoded exfiltration chain detected (no combination of base64/compression transform then sending sensitive data), no endpoint hijacking (no code redirecting environment variables or endpoints to unofficial addresses).

checked_items.zh: 出站仅发送用户要求推送的通知内容，未发现读取本地文件后外发的路径。
checked_items.en: Outbound only sends the notification content the user requested to push, no path reading local files and then exfiltrating was found.

evidence.zh: 外联面与凭证面已交叉核对：全部出站端点均为渠道官方 API 或用户配置地址，未见凭据读取与网络外发的组合链路；回调入口以密径 + IP 白名单防护（src/inbound/wxpusher-callback.mjs、src/inbound/http-callback.mjs）。
evidence.en: Outbound surface and credential surface have been cross-checked: all outbound endpoints are channel official APIs or user-configured addresses, no combined link of credential reading and network exfiltration found; callback entry protected with secret + IP whitelist (src/inbound/wxpusher-callback.mjs, src/inbound/http-callback.mjs).

checked_items.zh: 依赖审计：零运行时依赖（dependencies 为空）；可选依赖为三个官方 SDK（飞书、QQ 机器人、二维码渲染），peer 依赖为 @deepseek-ai/cordis；依赖名无 typosquatting 或与 dsh 生态内部命名撞车嫌疑。
checked_items.en: Dependency audit: zero runtime dependencies (dependencies is empty); optional dependencies are three official SDKs (Feishu, QQ bot, QR code rendering), peer dependency is @deepseek-ai/cordis; dependency names have no typosquatting or collition with dsh ecosystem internal naming.

checked_items.zh: 安装与配置面：无安装钩子；挂载配置仅插入插件行，未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全配置，无禁用安全项、无环境变量降权写法、无 inject/intercept 改写。
checked_items.en: Installation and configuration surface: no install hooks; patch configuration only inserts a plugin line, does not touch sandbox/approval/permission etc. security configurations, no disabling security items, no environment variable downgrade wording, no inject/interceptor rewrite.

checked_items.zh: 事件链检查：未对审批等安全事件做高优监听截断，审批处理器明确异常一律交还桌面处理。
checked_items.en: Event chain check: no high-priority listening for approval and other security events to intercept them; approval handler explicitly returns all exceptions to desktop processing.

checked_items.zh: 作者与版本：仓库结构完整、说明详尽；首版审计无上一版本基线可比较，升级自动激活类风险不适用。
checked_items.en: Author and version: repository structure complete, documentation detailed; first audit, no previous version baseline for comparison, upgrade auto-activation type risks not applicable.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 只插入一行插件配置（channels 为空），无安全行覆盖、无 disabled:true、无环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml only inserts one line of plugin configuration (channels empty), no security line override, no disabled:true, no environment variable downgrade wording.

evidence.zh: 源码中无对审批等安全事件的高优监听截断；审批路由注释与代码均明确静默永不批准、异常一律交还桌面（src/approval/router.mjs）。
evidence.en: Source code contains no high-priority listening to approval and other security events to intercept; approval routing comments and code explicitly state silent never approve, all exceptions returned to desktop (src/approval/router.mjs).

evidence.zh: 首版审计无上一版本基线可比较，无法做 manifest 声明突变的版本 diff 核查。
evidence.en: First audit, no previous version baseline for comparison, unable to perform version diff check for manifest declaration mutations.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写 inject/intercept，不涉及给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久等待。
evidence.en: Patch configuration does not rewrite inject/intercept, not involved in adding required services to security plugins causing permanent waiting.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件自启的 Web 服务：管理台默认只绑 127.0.0.1:8104 并带 Bearer token 鉴权（token 只存哈希），回调服务器默认只绑 127.0.0.1:8103 并带密径鉴权与 IP 白名单；代码明确永不绑公网。
checked_items.en: Checked Web services started by the plugin: admin console default binds only 127.0.0.1:8104 with Bearer token authentication (token stored only as hash); callback server default binds only 127.0.0.1:8103 with secret authentication and IP whitelist; code explicitly never binds to public network.

checked_items.zh: 服务健壮性：请求体 1MB 上限、SSE 连接数上限、请求/保持连接超时均已固化，异常处理不崩进程；未发现运行时自我修改或改写宿主函数。
checked_items.en: Service robustness: request body 1MB limit, SSE connection limit, request/keep-alive timeout all hardcoded, exception handling does not crash process; no runtime self-modification or rewriting of host functions found.

checked_items.zh: 宿主无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，本插件侧已自行加装鉴权与回环绑定，未见额外暴露面。
checked_items.en: Host without authenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk; this plugin side has added its own authentication and loopback binding, no additional exposure surface found.

evidence.zh: 插件启动的 Web 服务均绑定本机回环并带鉴权（src/admin/server.mjs 默认 127.0.0.1 + Bearer；src/inbound/http-callback.mjs 默认 127.0.0.1 + 密径）；宿主 webserver 无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: Web services started by the plugin all bind to local loopback with authentication (src/admin/server.mjs default 127.0.0.1 + Bearer; src/inbound/http-callback.mjs default 127.0.0.1 + secret); host webserver without authentication is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：package.json 声明 dsh.bundle.patch 指向 cordis.patch.yml，peer 依赖 @deepseek-ai/cordis，名称/仓库/作者一致，无仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: package.json declares dsh.bundle.patch pointing to cordis.patch.yml, peer dependency @deepseek-ai/cordis, name/repository/author consistent, no signs of impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态预扫 12 条机械命中全部人工裁决为良性并排除：DSH-X07(DG-R3-59) CI 仅跑测试；DSH-X02(DG-R3-54) 两处 install 均为元数据键而非 npm 安装钩子；DSH-X03(DG-R3-55) 的 spawn 均为 argv 数组直传不经 shell（另有文档文本与测试代码命中）；DSH-X05(DG-R3-57) 为管理台复制按钮。无 eval、无混淆、无真实安装钩子。
summary.en: Static pre-scan 12 mechanical hits all manually adjudicated as benign and excluded: DSH-X07(DG-R3-59) CI only runs tests; DSH-X02(DG-R3-54) two install fields are metadata keys, not npm install hooks; DSH-X03(DG-R3-55) hit points are argv array spawn (src/adapters/desktop.mjs, scripts/channel-login.mjs), documentation text (CHANGELOG.md) and test code (test/admin-server.test.mjs, test/desktop.test.mjs, test/public.test.mjs); DSH-X05(DG-R3-57) is admin console web copy button. All confirmed by code context to have no malicious behavior, none constitutes a finding.

summary.zh: 行为面干净：无安装期执行、无敏感路径读取、无编码外发链；全部网络端点均为各通知渠道官方 API 或用户配置的 webhook。
summary.en: Behavior surface clean: no install-time execution, no sensitive path reading, no encoded exfiltration chain; all network endpoints are official APIs of each notification channel or user-configured webhook.

summary.zh: AI 元数据面干净：notify/notify_test/ask_user 工具描述语义正常且带限流，无注入措辞；树内无 agent 指令文件。
summary.en: AI metadata surface clean: descriptions of notify/notify_test/ask_user tools semantically normal and rate-limited, no injection wording; no agent instruction files in tree.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙盒产物），本层按不适用处理。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification not performed (no dynamic sandbox artifact), this layer treated as not applicable.

limits.zh: 首版审计，无上一版本基线可比较，版本 diff 与升级相关场景按不适用处理。动态沙箱未启用（无 l4-sandbox.json），未做动态验证，运行时结论基于静态分析。插件未提供显式的 network/shell/fs 能力声明清单，declared_capabilities 与 capability_diff 依据代码实测与 dshWorkshop 元数据推断。静态预扫 12 条机械命中的排除明细（规则 ID 均已在 L1 层汇总）：DSH-X07(DG-R3-59) CI 工作流仅测试；DSH-X02(DG-R3-54) 两处为 dshWorkshop 元数据键、非 npm 安装钩子；DSH-X03(DG-R3-55) 命中点分别为 argv 数组 spawn（src/adapters/desktop.mjs、scripts/channel-login.mjs）、文档文本（CHANGELOG.md）与测试代码（test/admin-server.test.mjs、test/desktop.test.mjs、test/public.test.mjs）；DSH-X05(DG-R3-57) 为管理台网页复制按钮。以上均经代码上下文确认无恶意行为，无一条构成 finding。
limits.en: First audit, no previous version baseline for comparison, version diff and upgrade-related scenarios treated as not applicable. Dynamic sandbox not enabled (no l4-sandbox.json), dynamic verification not performed, runtime conclusions based on static analysis. Plugin does not provide explicit network/shell/fs capability declaration list, declared_capabilities and capability_diff inferred from code measurement and dshWorkshop metadata. Details of exclusion of 12 mechanical hits from static pre-scan (rule IDs already summarized at L1 layer): DSH-X07(DG-R3-59) CI workflow only tests; DSH-X02(DG-R3-54) two hits are dshWorkshop metadata keys, not npm install hooks; DSH-X03(DG-R3-55) hit points are argv array spawn (src/adapters/desktop.mjs, scripts/channel-login.mjs), documentation text (CHANGELOG.md) and test code (test/admin-server.test.mjs, test/desktop.test.mjs, test/public.test.mjs); DSH-X05(DG-R3-57) is admin console web copy button. All confirmed by code context to have no malicious behavior, none constitutes a finding.
